//go:build linux && (amd64 || arm64)

package text

// OrbitFractionalGlyphPositionsAvailable is a side-effect-free policy check:
// it may initialize the engine, but does not shape text or change its defaults.
func (s *System) OrbitFractionalGlyphPositionsAvailable() bool {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	_, ok := s.engine().(*pangoEngine)
	return ok && pangoLib.contextSetRoundPositions != nil
}
